title: worker-result.request
description: Execution result and evidence posted by pull-worker to Control Center (ADR-0027, issue #192). `idempotency_key` is the sole correlation handle back to the job the Control Center issued (together with `correlation_id`, `tenant_id`, `server_id` and the leasing `worker_id`) - there is deliberately no `job_id` field. Earlier v1 required `job_id` here, but nothing in this contract set (`worker-poll.response`, `operation-request`) ever gave the worker a server-known job id to echo back, so the field was in practice a client-invented opaque string the Control Center could never validate (issue #221). This was fixed by amending v1 in place rather than cutting a v2: this contract set has exactly one known consumer (AWCMS), which pins the OMES contracts directory by commit hash and has a CI drift gate on it (issue #197), so the break is detectable and cheap to re-pin today, and the field being removed was never actually implementable as a correlation handle. Consumers must re-pin/re-vendor after this change; see contracts/README.md "Compatibility rules" for the general additive-only policy this change is a documented, deliberate exception to.
